description: This file contains benchmark code for the Abseil hashing library, including various hash function tests, data structure benchmarks, and latency measurements.

classes.name: TypeErasedInterface
classes.description: Abstract base class for type-erased hash wrappers with a virtual HashValue method.

classes.name: TypeErasedAbslHash
classes.description: Template struct providing a wrapper class for hashing values of type T.

methods.name: RunBenchmark
methods.description: Template function to run a benchmark for a given hash type and value.

methods.name: AbslHashValue
methods.description: Friend function template to combine hash state with a wrapper object.

methods.name: ODRUseFunction
methods.description: Function to ensure a function pointer is used to prevent ODR issues.

methods.name: FlatCord
methods.description: Creates a flattened absl::Cord of specified size.

methods.name: FragmentedCord
methods.description: Creates a fragmented absl::Cord with chunks of 'a' characters.

methods.name: Vector
methods.description: Generates a vector of sequential values of type T.

methods.name: FastUnorderedSet
methods.description: Custom set-like structure with vector-based iteration for benchmarking overhead.

methods.name: FlatHashSet
methods.description: Creates an absl::flat_hash_set with sequential integer insertions.
